_about: A framework pack the engine's tests carry, never shipped (ADR-0008): its adapter reads a model that is already the architecture pack's reified model, so the core's handling of any framework's model is tested without naming one.
name: plain
summary: The plain architecture framework, for the engine's tests: a model file that holds the document and the proposal an adapter writes, read through the adapter seam like any framework's model.

changelog.note: First release (ADR-0008): the engine's tests stop reading CALM models; this adapter reads the reified model as a file.
